We need derive one local residual inside parent requirement R3. No claims. Mode probe, used_claims []. local_residual is one coherent exploratory evidence objective. Need not solve whole. Need identify one facet. Since no claims, choose exploratory evidence objective. Must preserve roles etc. Could be: identify an interview given by the partner (at time of artist's death) in which partner states that after artist's death the artist has become a direct reference to one of their songs. But that's basically whole parent. Need one coherent evidence objective, not bundle? It includes partner, interview, statement. Since no substantive supporting claim, probe. Maybe focus on the existence of such an interview by the partner. But local_residual should be one evidence objective inside parent. Could phrase: "Establish whether the partner of the musical artist at the time of the artist's death gave an interview containing the statement that after the artist's death, the artist has become a direct reference to one of their songs." This is one objective? It bundles partner and statement but it's the core relation. Alternatively target the interview: "Identify an interview given by the partner (at the time of the artist's death) in which the partner discusses the artist becoming a direct reference to one of the artist's songs following the death." That's essentially same.

Need adhere: no search query, no source, no plan. JSON only.

Should mode be "probe" because no substantive Claims. used_claims [].

Parent_requirement_id R3. local_residual string.

Need ensure not add outside knowledge. Preserve participant roles, relation, ownership, object scope, temporal attachment, uncertainty. The parent requirement includes: partner of the artist at time of death; interview; they said; following death; artist has become a direct reference to one of their songs. Could choose one facet: establish that the partner gave an interview. But the parent requirement is about interview content. Which is more coherent? Maybe residual: "Determine whether the partner of the artist at the time of the artist's death gave an interview in which the partner stated that, following the artist's death, the artist has become a direct reference to one of the artist's songs." That directly restates.

If no claims, probe. We can say "One exploratory evidence objective is to establish the existence and content of an interview by the artist's partner (at the time of death) in which the partner says the artist has become a direct reference to one of the artist's songs following the death." This is faithful. It does bundle existence and content but parent is one condition. It's okay.

Maybe better: "Identify the interview given by the artist's partner (at the time of the artist's death) where the partner made the statement that following the artist's death, the artist has become a direct reference to one of their songs." That's one evidence objective.

No search query. Good.
